name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to spot routinable patterns in real PRs without slowing anyone down. The trade-off is delayed feedback on open PRs, but merged PRs give us cleaner data to improve routing and prompts.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs only catches errors *after* they’re already in production—too late to prevent harm. Better to run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *open* PRs first; we’ll spot patterns sooner and can still refine prompts before they merge. Settle it by running a 2-week shadow test on open PRs and comparing the error detection rate to merged PRs.
